prompt.project_info: Natural photorealistic backyard lifestyle portrait with a modern house, greenery and a candid over-shoulder glance.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with tanned complexion, long wavy dark-brown hair reaching the lower back, rounded face, full lips, dark eyes and light bangs. She wears an oversized red quarter-zip sweatshirt and red-and-white horizontally striped high-waisted swim bottoms.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium full shot from mid-thigh upward, eye-level rear-three-quarter perspective. The woman stands on a grassy lawn with weight shifted naturally, looks back over her left shoulder toward camera with a neutral slightly pouty expression, and keeps the red sweatshirt draped loosely over her upper body. Preserve the striped swim-bottom design and relaxed rear-three-quarter pose without emphasizing body parts.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural diffused daylight from overhead and slightly front-right, realistic soft shadows and clear spatial separation between foreground, grass and pavers, modern house and trees.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic natural perspective without wide-angle distortion, sharp hair and fabric texture, medium full framing, realistic outdoor smartphone lifestyle finish.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a natural photorealistic backyard lifestyle portrait of one original approved adult woman with a tanned complexion, long wavy dark-brown hair reaching the lower back, soft rounded face, full lips, dark eyes and a light fringe of bangs. She wears a thick oversized red quarter-zip sweatshirt loosely over her upper body and high-waisted red-and-white horizontally striped swim bottoms. Use an eye-level rear-three-quarter medium full shot from mid-thigh upward. She stands on a grassy lawn with weight shifted naturally and looks back over her left shoulder toward the camera with a neutral slightly pouty expression. Include a modern dark-clad house with large glass windows reflecting greenery and a bedroom interior, wooden deck to the left, grass, grey stone pavers and lush trees. Use natural diffused daylight from overhead and slightly front-right, realistic soft shadows, clear spatial depth, natural perspective without wide-angle distortion and sharp realistic hair, skin and fabric texture.
